role: Collapsible session metrics bar displaying cost, graph changes, node count, and conversation turns
detail: React functional component that renders a Material-UI Collapse wrapper containing a Paper with a 4-column Grid layout. Displays session_cost_usd (formatted to 2 decimals), graph_changes count, total nodes all-time, and conversation_turns. All metrics sourced from useAppStore hooks (sessionStats, graphStats, sessionInfoExpanded). Styled with dark theme (#0f3460 background, white text). Toggled visibility controlled by sessionInfoExpanded state from app store.
